description: Places an artboard of the design into the smart mockup that suits its shape — a phone in a hand for a story, a poster frame for A-sizes and posts, a tee or tote for a square emblem, a laptop or a print for a wide banner — as a new artboard beside it (live if the design is open). If the design is open in Paletoo, the mockup is rendered and returned as a picture.

artboard.description: an artboard id (get_design); none: the first

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

kind.description: what to put it on; auto (default) picks by its shape

name: mockup_it
title: Put it in a mockup
